evidence.source: CUHK Humanum 漢語多功能字庫
evidence.text: Sun-plus-moon occurs in oracle-bone and bronze writing. Another early form, 朙, has 月 and window 囧, the latter also phonetic. Eye-plus-moon identification is uncertain; some later eye or field shapes are explained as corruptions.
evidence.title: 漢語多功能字庫 — 明
